title: Fernando Mendoza: It's good to learn from getting punched in the face

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Fernando Mendoza: It's good to learn from getting punched in the face
sources.description: Fernando Mendoza didn't look overmatched early in his first NFL start, but the road got tougher for the Raiders' rookie quarterback over the final three quarters of Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
